description: This file defines the BudgetProvider class in Dart, which manages the state and CRUD operations for budget data in a Flutter application. It interacts with a BudgetService for data fetching and updates, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: BudgetProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages a list of budgets, handles loading, adding, updating, and removing budget items, and notifies UI components about state changes via ChangeNotifier.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of budgets for the selected month from the service, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current month to the specified DateTime and triggers a reload of budgets.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new budget item via the service and adds it to the internal list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget item identified by id using the service, and refreshes the internal list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a budget item by id via the service and updates the internal list.
